facts.text: The resort is a 14th-century fort converted into a Six Senses sanctuary of well-being.
facts.excerpt: A beautiful 14th-century fort sensitively converted to become a Six Senses sanctuary of well-being.

facts.text: The fort was originally owned by a Rajasthani Royal Family.
facts.excerpt: Originally owned by a Rajasthani Royal Family, it faces the Chauth ka Barwara Mandir temple.

facts.text: The fort faces the Chauth ka Barwara Mandir temple.
facts.excerpt: it faces the Chauth ka Barwara Mandir temple

facts.text: The conservation effort incorporates two palaces and two temples within the walled fort.
facts.excerpt: The significant conservation effort incorporates two palaces and two temples within the walled fort.

facts.text: The fort has a view of the lake and temple.
facts.excerpt: enjoys a sensational view of the lake and temple

facts.text: The landscaping integrates purely endemic plants and water features.
facts.excerpt: The landscaping integrates purely endemic plants and water features.

facts.text: The property works with the local community to rewild the forests to the east and revive the sacred lake.
facts.excerpt: The property is working with the local community to rewild the forests to the east and revive the sacred lake to its former glory.

facts.text: Three restaurants serve Rajasthani-inspired fresh, sustainable cuisine.
facts.excerpt: The three restaurants take you on a culinary journey of specialized Rajasthani-inspired fresh, sustainable cuisine

facts.text: Each suite is designed in a contemporary Rajasthani style, subtly incorporating high tech and artwork.
facts.excerpt: Each suite is designed in a contemporary Rajasthani style to complement the historic backdrop of the fort while subtly incorporating high tech and elegant and surprising artwork

facts.text: Wellness combines the preventative principles of Ayurveda with Western influences.
facts.excerpt: Preventative principles of Ayurveda, along with Western influences, enhance the pursuit of well-being

facts.text: Suites have private terraces with views toward the Barwara Heritage village or the Chauth ka Barwara Mandir temple above the lake.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy the view from your private terrace towards the Barwara Heritage village or the Chauth ka Barwara Mandir temple high above the lake.

facts.text: The resort's palace domes rise from agricultural fields, yellow mustard flowers and rugged wilderness.
facts.excerpt: The palace domes of our Rajasthan resort await you, rising from fertile agricultural fields, yellow mustard flower and rugged wilderness
